تستردوا (form X)
# تَسْتَرِدُّوا (tastariddū) /tas.ta.rid.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرَدَّ (istaradda)
# تُسْتَرَدُّوا (tustaraddū) /tus.ta.rad.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرَدَّ (istaradda)
